claims: WrestleMania 42 occurs on April 18–19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 Night 1 is on Saturday, April 18.
WrestleMania 42 Night 2 is on Sunday, April 19.
WrestleMania 42 is at Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 starts at 6:00 p.m. ET / 3:00 p.m. PT.
WrestleMania 42 countdown starts at 5 p.m. ET.
WrestleMania 42 streams live exclusively on the ESPN App in the U.S.
Streaming WrestleMania 42 on the ESPN App requires an ESPN Unlimited subscription.
ESPN Unlimited subscription costs $29.99/month.
WrestleMania 42 streams on Netflix internationally.
The first hour of WrestleMania 42 Night 1 airs on ESPN2.
The first hour of WrestleMania 42 Night 2 airs on ESPN.
Fubo carries ESPN networks.
YouTube TV carries ESPN networks.
Hulu + Live TV carries ESPN networks.
DIRECTV Stream carries ESPN networks.
DIRECTV offers a 5-day trial.
Fubo offers a 5-day trial.
DIRECTV 5-day trial can be used to stream WrestleMania 42.
Fubo 5-day trial can be used to stream WrestleMania 42.
WrestleMania 42 includes Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton.
WrestleMania 42 includes a Triple Threat match with CM Punk, Roman Reigns, and Seth Rollins.
As of April 2026, WrestleMania is no longer streaming on Peacock in the U.S.
